extensions.activation.declinedToast.en: The extension code of “{plugin}” will not run. To activate it, disable and then enable the plugin in Settings.
extensions.activation.declinedToast.zh: 「{plugin}」的扩展代码不会运行。要激活它，在设置里先停用再启用这个插件。

extensions.activation.description.en: Newly installed extension code, not running yet
extensions.activation.description.zh: 刚安装的扩展代码，还没有运行

extensions.activation.dialog.body.en:
Extensions already hold session permissions: {holders}.

“{plugin}” was just installed from the plugin store. It contains extension code, which is not running yet. Extension code runs in the same process as other extensions, with no isolation between them. Once activated, its code can use these permissions too. Only activate plugins you trust.

If you keep it inactive, the plugin's skills and MCP still work.
extensions.activation.dialog.body.zh:
已有扩展持有会话权限：{holders}。

「{plugin}」刚从插件商店安装，它带扩展代码，还没有运行。扩展代码与其他扩展在同一个进程运行，彼此没有隔离。激活后，它的代码同样能使用这些权限。只激活你信任的插件。

不激活时，插件的技能与 MCP 照常可用。

extensions.activation.dialog.bodyUnknown.en:
The granted session permissions could not be checked.

“{plugin}” was just installed from the plugin store. It contains extension code, which is not running yet. Extension code runs in the same process as other extensions, with no isolation between them. Once activated, its code can use any permission granted to any extension. Only activate plugins you trust.

If you keep it inactive, the plugin's skills and MCP still work.
extensions.activation.dialog.bodyUnknown.zh:
无法确认已授予的会话权限。

「{plugin}」刚从插件商店安装，它带扩展代码，还没有运行。扩展代码与其他扩展在同一个进程运行，彼此没有隔离。激活后，它的代码同样能使用已授予任一扩展的权限。只激活你信任的插件。

不激活时，插件的技能与 MCP 照常可用。

extensions.grants.dialog.body.en:
Extension code runs in the same process as other extensions, with no isolation between them. Any enabled extension can technically use the permissions granted here. Only enable plugins you trust.

Read: the titles, status and full conversations of all sessions, including tool output. Write: create, fork, send messages to, interrupt, rename, open, archive and pin any session on this computer. If the target session runs in full access mode, a message from the plugin makes the Agent run tools directly.

Sessions in the plugin's project: the plugin can also approve or deny tool calls for you, answer the Agent's questions and switch the permission mode.

Actions started by a plugin show their source and are written to the audit log.
extensions.grants.dialog.body.zh:
扩展代码与其他扩展在同一个进程运行，彼此没有隔离。这里授予的权限，任何已启用的扩展在技术上都能使用。只启用你信任的插件。

读取：所有会话的标题、状态和完整对话，包括工具输出。写入：新建、分叉、发消息、中断、重命名、打开、归档、置顶本机任意会话。如果目标会话开着免确认模式，插件发的消息会让 Agent 直接执行工具。

插件项目里的会话：插件还能替你批准或拒绝工具调用、回答 Agent 的提问、切换权限模式。

插件发起的操作会标出来源，并写入审计日志。

extensions.grants.dialog.fullAccessBody.en: Full access: the plugin can switch sessions in its project to full access, so the Agent reads and writes files, runs commands and uses the network without asking. Only grant this to plugins you trust.
extensions.grants.dialog.fullAccessBody.zh: 完全访问：插件可以把它项目里的会话切到完全访问，Agent 读写文件、运行命令、访问网络都不再询问。只授予你信任的插件。

extensions.grants.dialog.notificationsBo.en: System notifications: the plugin can show system notifications while the window is in the background, with the plugin name before the title. At most 1 per minute and 20 per day. You can turn them off on the plugin details page; nothing is shown while system notifications are off in Settings.
extensions.grants.dialog.notificationsBo.zh: 系统通知：插件可以在窗口不在前台时弹出系统通知，标题前会加上插件名。每分钟最多 1 条、每天最多 20 条。可以在插件详情页单独关闭；设置里的系统通知开关关掉时一律不弹。

git.managedWorktree.error.session-close-.en: Couldn't unload the tasks using this worktree. The worktree was kept.
git.managedWorktree.error.session-close-.zh: 无法卸载使用这个 worktree 的任务，worktree 已保留

git.managedWorktree.error.session-failed.en: The worktree was created, but the task failed to start
git.managedWorktree.error.session-failed.zh: worktree 已创建，但任务启动失败

git.managedWorktree.error.slash-unsuppor.en: The first message of a worktree task can't be a command
git.managedWorktree.error.slash-unsuppor.zh: worktree 任务的第一条消息不支持命令

git.managedWorktree.error.start-ref-miss.en: The selected starting point doesn't contain the project folder
git.managedWorktree.error.start-ref-miss.zh: 所选起点中没有项目目录

git.managedWorktree.error.task-immovable.en: Worktree tasks can't be moved to another project
git.managedWorktree.error.task-immovable.zh: worktree 任务不能移动到其他项目

git.managedWorktree.error.unsupported-ag.en: This Agent version doesn't support worktrees
git.managedWorktree.error.unsupported-ag.zh: 当前 Agent 版本不支持 worktree

git.managedWorktree.error.worktree-in-us.en: A task is using this worktree
git.managedWorktree.error.worktree-in-us.zh: 有任务正在使用这个 worktree

git.managedWorktree.ref.note.en: The new worktree is created from the selected branch. Your local branch does not change. Uncommitted changes are not included.
git.managedWorktree.ref.note.zh: 新 worktree 将从所选分支创建，不切换本地分支。未提交的改动不会带入。

git.managedWorktree.ref.title.zh: 新 worktree 从哪个分支创建

git.managedWorktree.toggle.tooltip.en: Run in a new worktree: an isolated copy that works in parallel with your local checkout
git.managedWorktree.toggle.tooltip.zh: 在新的 worktree 中运行：创建独立副本，与本地并行工作

imageEditor.addedToChat.en: Added. You can remove it before sending.
imageEditor.addedToChat.zh: 已添加，发送前还可移除

imageEditor.unsavedDescription.en: Add the edited image to chat?
imageEditor.unsavedDescription.zh: 要把圈画后的图片添加到聊天吗？

imageEditor.unsavedTitle.en: Your drawing has not been added

login.agreement.prefix.en: By signing in, you agree to our

login.copyright.zh: © 2026 北京智谱华章科技股份有限公司

login.credentialStore.changed.en: The credential file has changed. Nothing was reset. Reload to use its current state.
login.credentialStore.changed.zh: 凭据文件已变化，本次没有重置。请重新加载以使用当前状态。

login.credentialStore.confirm.en: This resets all stored credentials. You will need to sign in again and reconfigure API keys, bots, MCP services and remote access. The original file will be preserved in a verified backup. Cancel to keep the original file unchanged.
login.credentialStore.confirm.zh: 此操作会重置全部已存凭据。你需要重新登录，并重新配置 API Key、Bot、MCP 服务及远程访问。原始文件会保存在经校验的备份中。取消则保持原文件不变。

login.credentialStore.description.en: The credential file is damaged. You can back it up and create an empty credential store.
login.credentialStore.description.zh: 凭据文件已损坏。可先备份原件，再建立空的凭据存储。

login.credentialStore.done.en: The original file was backed up and the empty credential store is ready. Reload to sign in again.
login.credentialStore.done.zh: 已备份原始文件，空凭据存储已就绪。请重新加载后登录。

login.credentialStore.failed.en: Recovery could not be completed or confirmed. Check the connection, available disk space and file permissions, then try again.
login.credentialStore.failed.zh: 无法完成或确认恢复结果。请检查连接、磁盘空间和文件权限后重试。

plugin.discovery.installAndEnable.en: Install and enable in this workspace
plugin.discovery.installAndEnable.zh: 安装并在当前工作区启用

plugin.discovery.responseFailed.en: Could not submit your choice. Please try again.

plugin.discovery.userInstall.en: Installed plugins are saved for this user. Configuration or authorization may still be required.
plugin.discovery.userInstall.zh: 插件安装到当前用户，使用前可能还需要配置或授权。

plugin.discovery.workspaceEnable.en: Enable this plugin in the current workspace.
plugin.discovery.workspaceEnable.zh: 将在当前工作区启用此插件。

plugin.discovery.workspaceInstall.en: Install the plugin and enable it in this workspace. Other workspace settings stay unchanged; configuration or authorization may still be required.
plugin.discovery.workspaceInstall.zh: 将安装插件并在当前工作区启用。其他工作区的启用设置不变；使用前可能还需配置或授权。

plugins.startupTimeout.en: Plugin loading timed out. Plugin skills, commands, MCP servers and hooks are unavailable for this run. Restart the app to try again.
plugins.startupTimeout.zh: 插件加载超时，本次未启用插件技能、命令、插件 MCP 和 Hook。重启应用后重试。

preview.image.actionFailed.en: Could not complete the image action. Please try again.

preview.image.saveAndChooseApp.en: Save a copy and choose an app
preview.image.saveAndChooseApp.zh: 保存副本并选择打开应用

projectManagement.confirm.descriptionOne.en: It leaves the sidebar and the project picker. Its sessions ({sessions}) stay in Recent and search. The folder on disk is not touched.
projectManagement.confirm.descriptionOne.zh: 它会从侧栏和项目选择器中移除，其中的会话（{sessions} 个）仍保留在最近和搜索中，磁盘上的文件夹不受影响。

remote.error.sourceServerUpdateInProgres.en: The remote device is updating its remote service
remote.error.sourceServerUpdateInProgres.zh: 远程设备正在更新远端服务

remote.error.sourceServerUpdateInProgres.en: This connection was not started. Retry after the update finishes.
remote.error.sourceServerUpdateInProgres.zh: 这次连接没有发起。等更新完成后点击重试。

remoteSync.minimized.failed.en: Sync needs attention. Click to view
remoteSync.minimized.failed.zh: 同步需要处理，点击查看

remoteSync.minimized.finished.en: Sync finished. Click to view results
remoteSync.minimized.finished.zh: 同步已结束，点击查看结果

remoteSync.minimized.pushing.zh: 正在同步… 点击查看

remoteSync.subagents.builtInModelWithRea.zh: 内置 · 模型 {model} · 推理档位 {level}

settings.browser.htmlClickOpensBrowser.en: Open HTML files in the built-in browser on click
settings.browser.htmlClickOpensBrowser.zh: 单击 HTML 文件时在内置浏览器中打开

settings.browser.htmlClickOpensBrowserDe.en: When on, clicking a local .html file in the file tree opens it in the built-in browser. When off, it opens the source preview. Open in the context menu always opens the source preview.
settings.browser.htmlClickOpensBrowserDe.zh: 开启后，在文件树中单击本地 .html 文件会在内置浏览器中打开；关闭时打开源码预览。右键菜单的「打开」始终打开源码预览。

settings.browser.htmlClickOpensBrowserSa.en: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.
settings.browser.htmlClickOpensBrowserSa.zh: 保存打开方式失败，请重试

settings.memory.viewer.remoteUnavailable.en: Memory details for remote devices are not available yet.
settings.memory.viewer.remoteUnavailable.zh: 暂不支持查看远程设备的记忆详情。

settings.mobilePushDescription.en: When you are away from this desktop, completed, failed, or waiting tasks are pushed to the signed-in ZCode App.
settings.mobilePushDescription.zh: 桌面不在身边时，任务完成、失败或需要确认会推送到已登录的 ZCode App。

settings.pluginAutoRecommendationDescrip.en: Let the agent find and recommend plugins in conversations. When off, you can still install plugins in Settings. Applies from your next message. Installation requires confirmation.
settings.pluginAutoRecommendationDescrip.zh: 允许 Agent 在对话中查找和推荐插件。关闭后仍可在设置页手动安装。从下一条输入生效，安装仍需确认。

settings.plugins.store.extension.consent.en: For information only. After you install, the plugin can use these permissions only after you grant them in the permission dialog.
settings.plugins.store.extension.consent.zh: 这里只是说明。安装后，要在授权对话框里授权，插件才能使用这些权限。

settings.plugins.store.extension.descrip.en: When enabled, the plugin's extension code keeps running inside ZCode.
settings.plugins.store.extension.descrip.zh: 启用后，插件的扩展代码在 ZCode 里常驻运行。

settings.plugins.store.extension.incompa.en: This plugin needs a newer version of ZCode. Update ZCode, then install it.
settings.plugins.store.extension.incompa.zh: 这个插件需要更新版本的 ZCode。更新 ZCode 后再安装。

settings.search.description.en: Find a setting and jump to it
settings.search.description.zh: 搜索设置项并跳转到对应位置

startup.global.exportLogsFailed.en: Failed to export logs. Please try again.
startup.global.exportLogsFailed.zh: 导出日志失败，请稍后重试。

startup.global.exportedLogs.en: Logs exported. Opened in the file manager.
startup.global.exportedLogs.zh: 日志已导出，已在文件管理器中打开。

taskList.archiveBlockedWhileRunning.en: Stop the task before archiving it
taskList.archiveBlockedWhileRunning.zh: 任务运行中，请先停止后再归档

voiceInput.error.audio_limit_exceeded.en: The recording reached the maximum length. The recognized text was kept.
voiceInput.error.audio_limit_exceeded.zh: 已达到单次录音时长上限，已保留识别到的文字。

voiceInput.error.audio_too_short.en: The recording is too short. Try again.

voiceInput.error.deviceBusy.en: The microphone cannot be used. Another app may be using it.
voiceInput.error.deviceBusy.zh: 麦克风无法使用，可能被其他应用占用。

voiceInput.error.deviceBusy.linux.en: The microphone cannot be used. Another app may be using it. Check the PulseAudio / PipeWire input device.
voiceInput.error.deviceBusy.linux.zh: 麦克风无法使用，可能被其他应用占用。请检查 PulseAudio / PipeWire 输入设备。

voiceInput.error.device_ended.en: The microphone was disconnected. Voice input was cancelled.
voiceInput.error.device_ended.zh: 麦克风已断开，本次识别已取消。

voiceInput.error.network.en: Cannot connect to speech recognition. Check your network.
voiceInput.error.network.zh: 无法连接语音识别服务，请检查网络。

voiceInput.error.noDevice.en: No microphone found. Connect a microphone and try again.
voiceInput.error.noDevice.zh: 未检测到麦克风，请连接麦克风后重试。

voiceInput.error.noDevice.linux.en: No microphone found. Connect a microphone and check the PulseAudio / PipeWire input device.
voiceInput.error.noDevice.linux.zh: 未检测到麦克风。请连接麦克风，并检查 PulseAudio / PipeWire 输入设备。

voiceInput.error.no_speech.en: No speech was recognized. Move closer to the microphone and try again.
voiceInput.error.no_speech.zh: 没有识别到内容，请靠近麦克风再说一次。

voiceInput.error.permissionDenied.linux.en: Cannot access the microphone. Check the system microphone permission and the PulseAudio / PipeWire input device.
voiceInput.error.permissionDenied.linux.zh: 无法访问麦克风。请检查系统的麦克风权限和 PulseAudio / PipeWire 输入设备。

voiceInput.error.permissionDenied.mac.en: ZCode cannot use the microphone. Allow ZCode in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone. On some macOS versions, restart the app after you change it.
voiceInput.error.permissionDenied.mac.zh: ZCode 没有麦克风权限。请在「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 麦克风」中允许 ZCode，部分系统版本需要重启应用后生效。

voiceInput.error.permissionDenied.window.en: ZCode cannot use the microphone. In Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone, turn on both "Microphone access" and "Let desktop apps access your microphone".
voiceInput.error.permissionDenied.window.zh: ZCode 没有麦克风权限。请在「设置 › 隐私和安全性 › 麦克风」中同时打开「麦克风访问权限」和「允许桌面应用访问麦克风」。

voiceInput.error.proxy.en: Cannot connect to speech recognition through the HTTP proxy. Make sure the proxy supports WebSocket, or add the service address to "No proxy", then restart the app.
voiceInput.error.proxy.zh: 无法通过 HTTP 代理连接语音识别服务。请确认代理支持 WebSocket，或把服务地址加入「不使用代理的地址」后重启应用。

voiceInput.error.rate_limited.en: Speech recognition is busy. Try again later.
voiceInput.error.rate_limited.zh: 语音识别繁忙，请稍后再试。

voiceInput.error.silent.en: No sound came from the microphone. Usually the system microphone permission is off or the wrong input device is selected.
voiceInput.error.silent.zh: 没有收到麦克风声音。通常是系统麦克风权限未开启或选错了输入设备。

voiceInput.error.silent.linux.en: No sound came from the microphone. Check the PulseAudio / PipeWire input device and volume.
voiceInput.error.silent.linux.zh: 没有收到麦克风声音。请检查 PulseAudio / PipeWire 的输入设备和音量。

voiceInput.error.too_quiet.en: No sound detected. Check that the microphone is not muted or too far away.
voiceInput.error.too_quiet.zh: 没有检测到声音，请检查麦克风是否静音或离得太远。

voiceInput.error.unavailable.en: Speech recognition is unavailable. Try again later.
voiceInput.error.unavailable.zh: 语音识别服务暂不可用，请稍后再试。

voiceInput.error.upstream_timeout.en: Speech recognition timed out. Try again.
